description: This file defines structures and a class for managing composite video input in a device, including singleton access and port management functions.

classes.name: device::CompositeInput
classes.description: A class that manages composite video input, providing methods to query port status, select ports, and scale video.

methods.name: device::CompositeInput::getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the CompositeInput class.

methods.name: device::CompositeInput::getNumberOfInputs
methods.description: Returns the number of inputs available.

methods.name: device::CompositeInput::isPresented
methods.description: Checks if the composite input is presented.

methods.name: device::CompositeInput::isActivePort
methods.description: Checks if a given port is active.

methods.name: device::CompositeInput::isPortConnected
methods.description: Checks if a specific port is connected.

methods.name: device::CompositeInput::scaleVideo
methods.description: Scales the video display to specified dimensions.
